userStories.title: Stop dropping shootout games from game-win training (R2-M3)
userStories.description: As the tool owner, I want every decided game in the game-win model's training/eval universe, so ~5-7% of each season (all shootout games) stops silently vanishing. (CODE_REVIEW_R2 R2-M3) Root cause: _pivot_games (ml/src/draft_oracle/models/game_win.py:253) filters games.loc[home_goals != away_goals], but the NHL archive stamps shootout games with EQUAL goals_for on both sides (the SO deciding goal is not counted) while the same rows carry the true decision in the win / wins_in_shootout / points columns. Measured: 65/952 games dropped in 2020-21, 77/1398 in 2024-25, 5.5-8.5% across all 11 seasons — excluded from training, Elo state updates, and the market-join target frame.
acceptanceCriteria: Read ml/SPEC.md AND the R2-M3 finding in ml/CODE_REVIEW_R2.md in full before starting

home_win is derived from the archive's win column (exactly one side has win=1 in every decided game), not from goal comparison; tied-goal rows with a decided winner are retained with the correct winner; genuinely undecided rows (if any exist) are still excluded loudly
Unit test on a real shootout fixture (e.g. game_id 2020020007: equal goals_for, home row points=2/wins=1) asserting it enters the pivoted frame with the correct home_win
Real-data invariant test: the pivoted frame's per-season game count equals the unique decided games in normalized team_games (2020-21: 952, 2024-25: 1398)
Elo updates and the market join now see SO games; the previously-unattachable covered 2021 odds rows (dropped-SO games) now attach — verify and note the count
